conceptual_change: Incorporate a mean-reversion filter identifying price divergence from the 20-period volume-weighted average price (VWAP) using a z-score of the distance from vwap to trigger mean-reversion entries.
rationale: The strategy utilizes the z-score of the distance from the vwap to identify periods where the price is statistically extended from the volume-weighted average, serving as a signal for mean reversion in crypto markets.
